name: Anime Vanguards: Wrathful Assault
desc:
Welcome To Vanguards! 

✨ All the worlds and universes need your help! An event has caused multiple worlds to collide. Summon units to fight these enemies and save these worlds and embark on a thrilling journey to become the strongest! ✨

🚀 Summon units to fend off enemies! 
🤩 Level Up and Evolve units to strengthen them for more battles to come! 
🔥 Play with your friends to fend off enemies in multiple game modes!
